Scope and content:  The original finding aid described this photograph as:
Original Caption: A group of ducks glide in front of the Ottawa National Wildlife Refuge Visitor Center.
Location: Location:

place.source_title: Visitor Center, Ottawa National Wildlife Refuge (2007)

brief: A 2007 wildlife-refuge visitor centre on a marsh pond: a lodge-like building with a steep green metal gabled roof, a big glazed gable window, stone piers and timber posts, geese on the water in front. One photo. Foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Ottawa National Wildlife Refuge visitor centre (Oak Harbor OH, 2007): a lodge-style building -- a steep green-metal gabled centre with a big arched glazed gable, lower wings, a stone chimney tower, a heavy-timber bracketed porch on stone piers; seen across a pond with geese

why.note: the 'park lodge' style of federal and state nature centres: rustic materials, big glass to the view
